classification_rules.ambiguous: resolved incremental edges of both signs across horizons, or a resolved edge that fails the block-stability floor, or a sign that flips between the raw and demeaned views
classification_rules.medium_horizon_persistence: the incremental edge after 5 s is resolved, positive and stable at some h >= 120 s
classification_rules.reversal: the incremental edge after 5 s is resolved and negative at some h > 5 s, and no resolved positive incremental edge at any longer horizon
classification_rules.short_continuation: the incremental edge after 5 s is resolved and positive at some h <= 60 s, and unresolved or negative at every h >= 120 s
classification_rules.ultra_short_only: cumulative edge is resolved at some h <= 5 s, and the incremental edge after 5 s is unresolved at every h > 5 s

cost_hurdles.label: diagnostic sensitivity values only
cost_hurdles.round_trip: twice the one-way hurdle, reported as arithmetic
cost_hurdles.units: basis points of notional, one way

dependence.non_overlapping_anchor_rule: within each segment, keep the rows whose index from the segment's first row is an exact multiple of h / 100 ms, so consecutive kept windows touch but never overlap

drift_control.reason: the corpus is a three-day 13-14 % BTC rally; at minute horizons the unconditional drift is a first-order contaminant of any mean markout

no_primary_horizon: the phase reports the profile across horizons; nominating one would be the selection this phase forbids

population.headline: oof_scored_rows
population.reason: the rows that carry every signal, so signals are compared on identical rows

prohibited_in_this_phase: training any model, horizon specific or otherwise
combining signals into a new score
selecting a horizon, threshold, decile or regime as best
any entry or exit rule, position sizing, stops, targets or holding-period optimisation
strategy PnL, Sharpe or equity curve
using any future return as a feature
reopening the falsified passive market-making line
reopening the falsified sub-second directional monetisation line
reading, loading or summarising post-native_dev_v1 AWS data or the Tardis holdout
re-freezing the failing passive_binary_sha256 audit gate

purge.applied_as: an evaluated row must sit at least (h + 60 s) after the start of its own validation block

question: does microstructure information that is real inside one second persist beyond five seconds, and does signal strength at t predict additional movement after t + 5 s rather than merely inheriting the first five seconds of it?

direction_p2_logistic.note: phase 2 headline direction model, blocked OOF, ROC AUC 0.7412

obi_l1.note: a raw observable, not a fitted score; it needs no fold and is defined on every row of the corpus

sweep_dir_p4a.note: phase 4A sweep model, scored OOF at 100 ms by phase 4B; the difference is the phase 5A direction convention expressed per instant and is not a fitted combination

status: descriptive decay study on frozen signals and development data; no model is trained and no horizon is selected

targets.agreement_rule: regenerated 1 s and 5 s must equal the frozen phase 1 columns exactly; 2 s is checked against the phase 5A reconstruction at that artifact's own published tolerance. Disagreement stops the phase.
targets.censoring: a horizon that would cross a segment edge is censored, never zero
targets.construction: forward shift of h / 100 ms rows inside the same segment
targets.definition: mid(t + h) - mid(t) in ticks, both mids read from the frozen phase 1 100 ms grid column mid_ticks

verdict_rules.A: current L2 monetisation closed - no signal shows a resolved positive incremental edge after 5 s at any horizon, and no gross edge at any horizon and any decile reaches the cheapest one-way hurdle of 1 bp
verdict_rules.B: longer-horizon information survives but is marginal - a resolved, stable positive incremental edge after 5 s exists, but the gross edge stays below a 2 bp round trip (the cheapest hurdle in the grid taken as 1 bp per side)
verdict_rules.C: economically material persistence - a resolved, stable gross edge at some horizon exceeds a 2 bp round trip, driven by incremental movement after 5 s rather than inherited from the first 5 s
verdict_rules.D: reversal structure - a resolved, stable negative incremental edge after 5 s dominates the profile
verdict_rules.E: insufficient data - at every horizon of 120 s and beyond the bootstrap interval on the decision quantity spans zero by more than the quantity itself, so the corpus cannot resolve the question either way
